about.text: Etken chay, also called süt chay, is a Uyghur milk tea of black tea boiled with an equal amount of milk and salt, sometimes with butter, sour cream or spices. Süt chay means 'milk tea' in Uyghur, and the drink is said to have come to China from India along the Silk Road.
